high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by Business Insider. The post features a video thumbnail with the title "One of the last dye houses in Egypt." The background shows a close-up view of yellow fabric being dyed, with vibrant colors and a blurred effect that emphasizes the texture and movement of the fabric. The text overlay on the image reads: "Salama Salem has been running his traditional dyehouse in Egypt since 1975. Click the link in our bio to see how, despite falling demand due to industrial competition and the COVID-19 pandemic, he continues to keep this tradition alive.
